title: How does facial recognition unlock a phone?

lines.text: How can your smartphone instantly unlock using your face, even when you're sitting in pitch-black darkness?
lines.caps: How does Face ID *unlock | in total pitch *darkness?

lines.text: It doesn't use a normal visual selfie camera.
Hidden in the notch is a flood illuminator and a microscopic vertical-cavity laser called a dot projector.
lines.caps: Fires an invisible *dot projector | and flood *illuminator

lines.text: The dot projector beams thirty thousand invisible infrared light dots directly onto your face.
An infrared camera reads the reflected dot grid, capturing a precise three-dimensional mathematical contour of your face.
lines.caps: Infrared camera captures a *3D map | of your facial *depth

lines.text: A dedicated neural engine compares this depth map against enrolled biometric templates in under a tenth of a second.
lines.caps: Neural engine verifies *depth | so a flat photo cannot *fool it

lines.text: Because it reads true geometric depth with invisible infrared, photos or sleeping eyes can never unlock it.
lines.caps: Infrared depth makes it *impossible | for flat photos to *cheat!
